tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: sand.900. Body, values, titles. Contrast: surface-default 17.0:1, bg-chat 15.1:1, bg-canvas 13.7:1.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: sand.700. Labels, captions. Contrast: surface-default 6.9:1, bg-chat 6.1:1, bg-canvas 5.5:1.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: sand.600. Placeholders, meta. Contrast: surface-default 4.8:1, bg-chat 4.3:1, bg-canvas 3.9:1. Below 4.5:1 on bg-chat, bg-canvas: kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: sand.500. Timestamps, table headers. Contrast: surface-default 3.7:1, bg-chat 3.2:1, bg-canvas 2.9:1. Below 4.5:1 on surface-default, bg-chat, bg-canvas: kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.usage: ember.700. Links, needs-input. Contrast: surface-default 5.3:1, bg-chat 4.7:1, bg-canvas 4.2:1. Below 4.5:1 on bg-canvas: kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: sand.0. On ink and ember. On action-primary 17.0:1; on action-accent 2.7:1 (below 4.5:1: kept exact from the source).

tokens.name: border-marked
tokens.usage: Ink 40%. The 1.5px ring on a field the agent updated (board 1c).

tokens.name: action-accent
tokens.usage: ember.500. Accent buttons: the gentle confirm.

tokens.name: action-destructive-hover
tokens.usage: #9C2F23. Destructive button hover (board 3). Not on the primitive scale.

tokens.name: action-hover-tint
tokens.usage: Ink 5%. Secondary and text button hover fill (board 3).

tokens.name: action-primary-pressed
tokens.usage: sand.900. Primary while pressed: back to full ink from the lighter hover. Not drawn on the boards; added Oct 6.

tokens.name: action-destructive-pressed
tokens.usage: #85281E. Destructive while pressed, a step past its hover. Not drawn; added Oct 6.

tokens.name: action-pressed-tint
tokens.usage: Ink 10%. Secondary, text and icon buttons while pressed. Not drawn; added Oct 6.

tokens.name: action-surface-pressed
tokens.usage: sand.150. The surface button (Stop) while pressed. Not drawn; added Oct 6.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: sage.700. Ready to submit, Final. Contrast: surface-default 5.5:1, bg-chat 4.9:1, bg-canvas 4.4:1. Below 4.5:1 on bg-canvas: kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: status-required
tokens.usage: ember.800. Needs input. Contrast: surface-default 7.4:1, bg-chat 6.5:1, bg-canvas 5.9:1.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: red.700. Errors. Contrast: surface-default 5.9:1, bg-chat 5.3:1, bg-canvas 4.8:1.

tokens.name: status-review
tokens.usage: ember.700. In progress. No fill. Contrast: surface-default 5.3:1, bg-chat 4.7:1, bg-canvas 4.2:1. Below 4.5:1 on bg-canvas: kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: status-neutral
tokens.usage: sand.700. Default tags. Contrast: surface-default 6.9:1, bg-chat 6.1:1, bg-canvas 5.5:1.

tokens.name: skeleton-sheen
tokens.usage: White 90%. The moving band, 20% to 50% to 80% (board 1c).

tokens.name: count-badge-bg
tokens.usage: Ink 8%. The count badge on an inactive tab (board 3).

tokens.name: tabs-rule
tokens.usage: Ink 8%. The rule under a tab row (board 3).

tokens.name: tooltip-rich-body
tokens.usage: White 82%. Body lines in a rich tooltip.

tokens.name: tooltip-shortcut-bg
tokens.usage: White 16%. The shortcut chip in a label tooltip.

tokens.name: suggestion-chip-bg
tokens.usage: White 80%. The SuggestionChip fill under its ember ring (V1.1 option F; A7, N1, N2).

tokens.name: starter-chip-bg
tokens.usage: White 32%. The hero Starters pills (U22): Describe it, Paste an email, Drop a brief.

tokens.name: drop-veil
tokens.usage: Warm white 96%. The composer's veil under Drop to attach (M7).

tokens.name: upload-track
tokens.usage: Ink 8%. The 2px track under a staged AttachmentThumb's upload bar (M5).

tokens.name: starter-chip-edge
tokens.usage: Ink 5%. The Starters pills' 1px inset edge (U22).

tokens.name: flow-header-separator
tokens.usage: #C9C2B9. The slash between brand and title in the FlowHeader (A1).

tokens.name: question-option-active
tokens.usage: Ink 6%. ComposerQuestion option row under the pointer or keyboard focus (A2, A3, K1).

tokens.name: question-option-key-edge
tokens.usage: Ink 10%. The 1px edge on a ComposerQuestion option's number key (A2).

tokens.name: table-head-rule
tokens.usage: Ink 14%. The rule under an AgentMessage table header (I1).

tokens.name: surface-preview
tokens.usage: sand.50. The preview well beside the brand library list (J3).

tokens.name: selected-row-bg
tokens.usage: Ink 4%. A chosen row in a picking modal: the brand library's selected item (E7, J3) and the submit modal's project (PR-ZV).

tokens.name: submit-dot
tokens.usage: ember.500. The dots of the Solstice mark gathering on the submitted moment (9b).

tokens.name: spinner-track
tokens.usage: #E4DED7. The ring behind the MessageBar progress spinner's ink head (A1, C1). Not on the primitive scale.

tokens.name: file-row-hover
tokens.usage: #F5F2EE. A ReferenceFilesTable row under the pointer; its remove × turns ink (C3). Not on the primitive scale.

tokens.name: rich-text-active
tokens.usage: Ink 8%. The fill behind an active RichTextArea toolbar button (I4). Board 1c names surface.band for this; the frame draws ink 8%.

tokens.name: rich-text-rule
tokens.usage: Ink 8%. The 1px rule under the RichTextArea toolbar (I4).

tokens.name: rich-text-divider
tokens.usage: Ink 10%. The 1px by 16px dividers between RichTextArea toolbar groups (I4).

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: 44px. Spectral 300. What are we working on?

styles.name: doc-title
styles.usage: 28px. Spectral 300, text.secondary. The request summary title. Set in text-secondary.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: 17px. Aileron 500. The request title on the submitted moment (9b). Aileron ships no 500 file, so 500 renders at 400.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: 15px. Aileron 400. Chat messages and paragraph copy.

styles.name: dialog-body
styles.sample: Answer the open question to submit
styles.usage: 14px. Aileron 400. A dialog's message. Drawn on board 7, not listed on board 1b.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: 14px. Aileron 500. A md button or a tab label. Drawn on board 3, not listed on board 1b. Aileron ships no 500 file, so 500 renders at 400.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: 13px. Aileron 400 or 500. Field values, row labels, a sm button.

styles.name: label-caps
styles.usage: 12px. Aileron 600, uppercase. Section labels. Set uppercase.

styles.name: table-head
styles.usage: 11px. Aileron 600, uppercase. Table headers, count badges. Set uppercase.

shadow.note: Every value is a complete box-shadow. Field rings are inset; focus-ring is for :focus-visible only.

tokens.name: elevation-edge
tokens.usage: Ink 6% ring. A white surface on the canvas.

tokens.name: elevation-composer-focus
tokens.usage: 0 8px 24px, no ring. The composer lifts on focus.

tokens.name: elevation-panel-ready
tokens.usage: The panel at the peak of motion.readyGlow: a status.success edge and a 6px success halo over elevation.panel (A5).

tokens.name: elevation-chip
tokens.usage: SuggestionChip at rest (V1.1 option F): a 1px action.accent ring inside the edge at 45%, and a 1px ink-4% shadow.

tokens.name: elevation-chip-hover
tokens.usage: SuggestionChip hover: the same ring deepened to 70% (V1.1 chips, round 3).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px white gap and a 2px ink ring at 32%. :focus-visible only.

tokens.name: field-editing
tokens.usage: Inset 1px border.focus plus a 3px ink halo at 6%.

tokens.name: field-error
tokens.usage: Inset 1.5px red.700, no halo (E1, E3b): only focus gets the halo.

tokens.name: elevation-menu
tokens.usage: Edge at ink 8% plus 0 8px 24px ink 14%. The AttachMenu dropdown (M1, M2).

tokens.name: drop-ring
tokens.usage: A 1.5px ink 20% ring inside the composer's edge, over a lifted shadow: the composer while a file is dragged over it (M7, Oct 6).

tokens.name: elevation-thumb-staged
tokens.usage: AttachmentThumb in the composer, before send: a firmer 1px edge at ink 10% (M5, M6).

tokens.name: field-editing-rich
tokens.usage: RichTextArea while focused: a 1.5px ink ring and a 3px ink 8% halo (I4, board 3b). Heavier than field.editing, as drawn.

tokens.name: size-sm
tokens.usage: 32px. Fields, sm buttons, small icon buttons.

tokens.name: layout-doc-panel-min
tokens.usage: 360px. The request panel's narrow and minimum width.

tokens.name: layout-doc-panel-max
tokens.usage: 45vw. The request panel's max and its drag limit: 55/45 (632px plus its gutter at 1440, A5).

tokens.name: layout-doc-panel-header
tokens.usage: 60px. The request panel header, holding the state button (Submit, Preparing, Updating, Stopped).

tokens.name: layout-chat-narrow-panel
tokens.usage: 840px. The chat column beside the narrow panel.

tokens.name: layout-chat-wide-panel
tokens.usage: 640px. The chat column beside the wide panel, 76px margins.

tokens.name: overlay-scrim-blur
tokens.usage: 2px. The backdrop blur under the scrim (J1 to J3). D1 draws the scrim without it; one scrim is used for both.

zIndex.note: Stacking by role. Never a raw z-index.
